title: Sequelize #8384: DATEONLY fields sanitized wrong when NULL

error_signal.message: sequelize TypeError: Cannot read properties of null when sanitizing DATEONLY field with NULL value in data-types

ground_truth.root_cause_description: DATEONLY type parser does not check for null before calling string methods. When a DATEONLY column has NULL value, the sanitizer crashes.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null check in DATEONLY sanitization
